# teams_schedule (Resource)

Manages a Teams auto attendant schedule via New-CsOnlineSchedule / Get-CsOnlineSchedule / Set-CsOnlineSchedule / Remove-CsOnlineSchedule. Exactly one of weekly or fixed must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "teams_schedule" "business_hours" {
  name = "Business hours"

  weekly {
    monday    = [{ start = "08:00", end = "12:00" }, { start = "13:00", end = "17:00" }]
    tuesday   = [{ start = "08:00", end = "17:00" }]
    wednesday = [{ start = "08:00", end = "17:00" }]
    thursday  = [{ start = "08:00", end = "17:00" }]
    friday    = [{ start = "08:00", end = "16:00" }]
  }
}

resource "teams_schedule" "holidays" {
  name = "Holidays 2026"

  fixed {
    date_range = [
      { start = "2026-12-25T00:00:00", end = "2026-12-26T00:00:00" },
      { start = "2026-12-31T12:00:00", end = "2027-01-02T00:00:00" },
    ]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the schedule.

### Optional

- `fixed` (Block, Optional) Fixed date ranges, e.g. holidays. Changing to weekly requires replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--fixed))
- `weekly` (Block, Optional) Weekly recurring hours. Changing to fixed requires replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--weekly))

### Read-Only

- `associated_configuration_ids` (List of String) Ids of the auto attendants using the schedule.
- `id` (String) Schedule id.

<a id="nestedblock--fixed"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fixed`

Optional:

- `date_range` (Attributes List) Date ranges. Required when the fixed block is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fixed--date_range))

<a id="nestedatt--fixed--date_range"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fixed.date_range`

Required:

- `end` (String) End, local date and time without zone. Must be after start.
- `start` (String) Start, local date and time without zone, e.g. 2026-12-25T00:00:00.



<a id="nestedblock--weekly"></a>
### Nested Schema for `weekly`

Optional:

- `complement` (Boolean) Apply the schedule outside the listed hours instead of during them. Defaults to false.
- `friday` (Attributes List) Time ranges on Friday. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--weekly--friday))
- `monday` (Attributes List) Time ranges on Monday. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--weekly--monday))
- `saturday` (Attributes List) Time ranges on Saturday. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--weekly--saturday))
- `sunday` (Attributes List) Time ranges on Sunday. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--weekly--sunday))
- `thursday` (Attributes List) Time ranges on Thursday. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--weekly--thursday))
- `tuesday` (Attributes List) Time ranges on Tuesday. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--weekly--tuesday))
- `wednesday` (Attributes List) Time ranges on Wednesday. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--weekly--wednesday))

<a id="nestedatt--weekly--friday"></a>
### Nested Schema for `weekly.friday`

Required:

- `end` (String) End time, HH:MM or HH:MM:SS; 24:00 is the end of the day. Must be after start.
- `start` (String) Start time, HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.
